coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in his own room, with the fan on low for steady white noise
Waking up slowly on the public holiday and washing up: shower, teeth, and changing into comfortable day clothes
Making and eating a relaxed flexitarian breakfast of toast, eggs and fruit with a pot of tea, then rinsing his dishes
Sitting at his desk with the lamp on, checking his written reminder list, reviewing his weekly budget in cash envelopes and noting the bills due
Sorting laundry and running the washing machine with a full load of clothes and towels, then hanging items to dry
Boiling the kettle and drinking a cup of tea while reading a printed article for his social work coursework
Studying quietly at his desk: reading assigned readings on the monitor and typing detailed notes for his Master of Social Work coursework
Preparing and eating a simple vegetarian lunch of rice, lentils and vegetables, using the rice cooker and induction cooker
Travelling by public transport to his regular animal shelter volunteering shift
Volunteering at the animal shelter: cleaning kennels, refilling water bowls and gently socialising the dogs
Taking the train and bus home from the animal shelter
Unwinding with a cup of tea and a light snack after volunteering
Writing a short, detailed written note reminding himself of the household meeting points and shared-space agreements he wants to raise
Cooking a batch of flexitarian dinner, stir-frying vegetables with tofu and reheating rice
Eating dinner slowly at the table and drinking water with his meal
Cleaning the cooking surfaces, wiping the bench and loading the dishwasher after dinner
Sending text messages to his family in China and looking at the saved photo of his family dog on his phone
Quiet leisure at his desk: reading a book and doing a short breathing exercise to settle his anxiety
Evening wind-down: brushing teeth, washing his face and turning on the dehumidifier as he tidies up
Going to bed early for a full night of sleep, with the light off and the fan humming quietly
